Prepare two sets of self-attested photocopies of all required documents and certificates.
Ensure you have your original educational certificates, mark sheets, proof of date of birth, and other supporting papers.
Attend the walk-in interview on 14 October 2026.
Report at the venue by 10:00 AM on the interview date.
Proceed to CSB-Central Sericultural Germplasm Resources Centre, Thally Road, Hosur, Tamil Nadu - 635109 for the interview process.
important_instructions: No TA or DA will be provided to attend the interview. The position is purely temporary, on a contractual basis, and are co-terminus with the project. The recruitment procedures will be followed as per the Guidelines of Central Silk Board for hiring of Research Fellow (JRF/SRF/RA) under CSB-coded R&D projects. The decision of the Director, CSB-CSGRC, Hosur shall be final and binding in all respects.

faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post.
